effects.display_name: Native armor admission, attacker responses and literal evasion
effects.actual_behavior: Two independent victim-equipment branches remain native. Complete Eternal OR Immortal first writes SOURCE absolute(cos(radians(sourceYaw-90))/2,.6,sin(radians(sourceYaw-90))/2),requests source Wither30/1 using native three-argument constructor,then source fire3 seconds. Original amount<=5 requests VICTIM Invisibility10/native amplifier1,false,false and cancels. Otherwise current victim EternalEvasion admits priority+X,-X,-Z,+Z, comparing current victim coordinate against HEAD custom-data etdirx/etdirz. Each direction requires feet and Y+1 destination-block destroySpeed<.2,INCLUDING negative hardness; this is not an air/collision-safety test. On admission source Player shadertime20 is presentation,original cancels,then victim teleportTo to current coordinate+/-1 and,if ServerPlayer,connection.teleport RECOMPUTES coordinate+/-1 AFTER the first call. These are two native destination requests,not an invented deduplicated teleport or guaranteed two-block relocation. Independently the common armor branch: complete Infernal/Umbral/Spectral/Spacetime OR Eternal chest OR Immortal chest requests source Glowing10/native amplifier1 and cancels for amount<=1; Immortal chest independently repeats glow/cancel for amount<=5. Then fresh nextInt(1,2)==2 burns SOURCE3 seconds,otherwise source Wither30/1; always SOURCE absolute yaw motion with horizontal divisor2,Y.6. For outfits outside that common branch, exactly3/2/1 Infernal pieces give source horizontal divisor4/6/8,Y.6;zero Infernal pieces gives no such movement. Thus full Eternal/Immortal can run both first and common branches and repeat source movement/status/fire natively. No hurt-success/KnockbackResistance gate is present; defensive amount/clearance/invisibility/admission values are preserved rather than automatically Stage candidates.
